description_en: Queries the domain ownership verification content of a Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-verify-content --instance-id waf_v2_public_cn-000 --domain-name example.com --access-origin share --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeVerifyContent

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to query the ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The domain name that you want to query for ownership verification content
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The source of the domain name. Valid values:

share: The domain name is added to WAF in CNAME record mode.

asset: The domain name is added to WAF as a custom asset.

hybrid_cloud_cname: The domain name is added to WAF in hybrid cloud CNAME record mode.

tgw: The domain name is added to WAF in cloud native mode
parameters.help_zh:
接入来源。取值：

share：表示公共云CNAME接入。

asset：表示自定义资产接入。

hybrid_cloud_cname：表示混合云CNAME接入。

tgw：表示云产品接入
parameters.name: access_origin

DnsContent.description_en: The DNS-based verification content, including the TXT record details

RR.description_en: The host record of the DNS TXT record used for domain ownership verification

Type.description_en: The type of the DNS record used for verification

Value.description_en: The value of the DNS TXT record used for verification

FileContent.description_en: The file-based verification content, including the file name, path, and download URL

DownloadUrl.description_en: The download URL of the verification file

FileName.description_en: The name of the verification file

TopDomain.description_en: The root domain of the domain name to be verified

Value.description_en: The content of the verification file

VerifyPath.description_en: The URL that is used to access the verification file

VerifyResult.description_en: Indicates whether the domain ownership verification is successful
VerifyResult.description_zh:
校验结果。取值：

true：表示校验通过。

false：表示校验不通过
